findings.body: After a successful visit, navigating away and back can render cached cards before the new membership check completes. `isFetched` is already true, so this branch skips the loading state and renders `cards.data` while `refetchOnMount` runs. If the holder has left or been removed, their cards remain visible until the 404 arrives, or longer if the request stalls. [TanStack Query documents background refetches and retention of inactive cached data](https://tanstack.com/query/latest/docs/framework/react/guides/important-defaults). Gate the cards on a successful check for this visit, or discard this sensitive query when leaving. The browser test uses a full page reload, which clears this cache and misses the case.
